name: Hankai
source:
「I, too, have to become stronger to protect Nee-san.」

She is the shock troop commander of [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url]'s army. A big sister who enjoys pampering.

She's [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url]'s childhood friend and younger sister. She likes everyone in [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url]'s army, who can smile even after many defeats, and [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url], who can make everyone smile happily.

Individually, she is as strong as [url=https://vndb.org/c136820]Kouu[/url], and she continues to support the weak [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url]'s army by herself.

She is at first apprehensive of [url=https://vndb.org/c136830]Shibasen[/url] as a suspicious person approaching [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url], but after trusting him with her true name, she gradually begins to coddle him and treat him overly protectively.
